## What GEO is
Generative engine optimization is the practice of getting a brand named inside
AI-generated answers — the paragraph ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews
or Copilot returns instead of a list of links. It differs from SEO in emphasis:
entity consistency, answer-first page structure, structured data and
third-party corroboration matter more than link volume or keyword density.
It is also called answer engine optimization (AEO) or AI search optimization;
the three names describe the same job.

## The four published figures this practice is built on
- ~90% of ChatGPT search citations point to pages ranking 21 or lower
  (Semrush, AI Search & SEO Traffic Study, July 2025).
- An AI-referred visitor is worth about 4.4x an ordinary organic visitor
  (Semrush, 2025).
- Clickthrough for the top-ranking page drops about 34.5% when an AI Overview
  appears above it (Ahrefs, 2025).
- Email marketing returns about 45:1 in retail and e-commerce (Litmus, 2025).

## GEO vs SEO, in one line each
- What you win: a slot in ten links (SEO) vs a named mention in one paragraph (GEO).
- Measurement: keyword rank (SEO) vs citation share across a prompt set (GEO).
- Source depth: positions 1-10 (SEO) vs ~90% of citations from 21+ (GEO).
- Primary lever: links and coverage (SEO) vs entity consistency, extractable
  answers and corroboration (GEO).
- Time to signal: 3-6 months (SEO) vs 6-10 weeks for entity fixes, a quarter
  for citation share (GEO).

## The method, in order
1. Read the revenue data with a model — cluster tickets, reviews and CRM notes.
2. Build the prompt set — 150-400 buyer questions weighted by revenue.
3. Fix the entity, then the pages — one name, one category, one claim; then
   answer-first rewrites of the highest-intent pages.
4. Earn corroboration — get named in the roundups, comparison pages and review
   platforms the models already retrieve from.
5. Convert it with email — lifecycle and outbound sequences behind the traffic.

## Engagements
- Visibility Audit — $4,500 fixed, 3 weeks. Revenue-weighted prompt set,
  baseline citation share across four answer engines, entity audit, technical
  read, email teardown, ranked 90-day fix list.
- Answer Engine Program — $9,800/month, 6-month minimum. Live citation
  scoreboard, extractable answer pages, schema and entity engineering,
  corroboration outreach, parallel SEO, monthly revenue readout.
- Owned Channel Build — $6,400/month, 3-month minimum. Cold email
  infrastructure and deliverability, AI-built customer profile from won/lost
  history, lifecycle flows, revenue attribution.

## Who it is for
Direct-to-consumer brands, B2B SaaS companies and multi-location service
businesses doing $50K-$1M a month, where a shortlist decision is being made by
an AI assistant before anyone visits a website.

## Cited is not the same as recommended
Ahrefs read 9,886 AI answers across four engines in 2026 (34 pages, 5 domains,
February-May). Among answers that cited their own page, 43% never mentioned
their brand - the model used the source and recommended a competitor from it.
For an established brand, 94% of new mentions came from third-party pages and
only 6% from answers citing its own content. A cited page appeared on about one
day in three. A narrow query returned a 66.4% mention rate against 15.8% for a
broad one. Source: https://ahrefs.com/blog/self-promotional-content-ai-seo-experiment/

## The Answer Layer
A free weekly newsletter, Tuesdays, 11,400 subscribers. One brand, twenty buyer
prompts, four engines, and exactly why the assistants do or do not name it.
Sign up at https://syed.ai/#newsletter

## Free automated roadmap
Anyone can request an automated read of their own site from the chat on the
site. It checks the homepage, robots.txt and llms.txt, then emails a ranked fix
list and a ninety-day sequence. No charge and no call required.
